mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and enhance corticosteroid absorption while also potentiating immunosuppressive and anti-inflammatory effects, potentially increasing hydrocortisone bioavailability and adverse effects.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess (hyperglycemia, hypokalemia, immunosuppression); consider spacing administration and inform patients to avoid excessive turmeric supplementation without medical supervision.
